name: Gluco
tagline: A simple chat log for glucose readings, meals and meds, plus a daily wrap-up
description: A chat-based logbook for glucose, meals and medication, kept plain on purpose. Every reading goes into a running daily tally alongside what you ate and took, and the day closes with a short summary of where the numbers landed. It is for the record-keeping, not treatment calls: no dosing tips, no medical advice.
author: Brianhill
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
